reason: A tracked machine.static_pass_commit value cannot equal the hash of the same commit that introduces that value: changing the tracked value changes the commit object and therefore its hash. Registering the already-created static report in a later commit also makes HEAD differ from the earlier implementation commit. The R02 runner predicate therefore cannot prove a committed static-PASS state without an uncommitted machine edit or history manipulation.
prohibited_workarounds: edit the hash-bound R02 runner after its static PASS
required_recovery: Create C00 revision-3 in a new config/source/output namespace. Bind the immutable R02 50/50 report and this audit, and replace only the self-referential equality with a committed-state rule that requires synchronized HEAD/origin plus an already published static-pass registration commit. Keep all circuit inputs, checks, thresholds, budgets and failure retention unchanged.
evidence_boundary: This is a pre-execution Git-gate audit, not a runner invocation, circuit simulation, topology failure, convergence result, VTC, delay, power, physical parameter, experimental calibration or downstream evidence. R02 remains immutable and no circuit execution is permitted.
